clips.send: Draw the diagonal of a unit square. It splits a right angle in half, giving 45°. Both legs are 1, so the Pythagorean theorem gives a diagonal of the square root of 2.
clips.text: Draw the diagonal of a unit square. It splits a right angle in half, giving 45°. Both legs are 1, so the Pythagorean theorem gives a diagonal of √2.

clips.send: The incline angle is the angle the ramp makes with the horizontal. The slope ratio is vertical rise divided by horizontal run, which equals the tangent of that angle. In the U.S., percent grade expresses this ratio as a percentage.
clips.text: The incline angle is the angle the ramp makes with the horizontal. The slope ratio is vertical rise divided by horizontal run, which equals the tangent of that angle. In the U.S., percent grade expresses this ratio as a percentage.

clips.send: Measure up from the observer’s horizontal to the line of sight for the angle of elevation. Measure down for the angle of depression. Looking along the same line from opposite ends gives equal angles because the horizontals are parallel.
clips.text: Measure up from the observer’s horizontal to the line of sight for the angle of elevation. Measure down for the angle of depression. Looking along the same line from opposite ends gives equal angles because the horizontals are parallel.

clips.send: Two right triangles with the same acute angle are similar. All corresponding lengths scale by the same factor, so the ratios stay the same. Pick the reference angle first. Choosing the other acute angle swaps the roles of the two legs.

clips.send: To solve a right triangle, find its missing sides and angles. Given a side and an acute angle, choose a ratio linking the known side to the side you want. Given two sides, use their ratio to find an angle and the Pythagorean theorem to find the third side.

clips.send: Draw an altitude from the top of an equilateral triangle with side length 2. It halves the 60° top angle and the base. Each right triangle has a 30° angle at the top and a 60° angle at the base. The short leg is 1. The other leg is the square root of (2 squared minus 1 squared ) equals the square root of 3.
clips.text: Draw an altitude from the top of an equilateral triangle with side length 2. It halves the 60° top angle and the base. Each right triangle has a 30° angle at the top and a 60° angle at the base. The short leg is 1. The other leg is √(2² − 1²) = √3.

clips.send: 两个直角三角形只要有一个相等的锐角，就相似。对应边同时乘以同一个数，所以比值不变。先确定所选的锐角，再认对边和邻边；换成另一个锐角，两条直角边的角色就交换了。

clips.send: 在边长为 1 的正方形中画一条对角线。对角线平分直角，得到 45 度 。两条直角边都是 1，由勾股定理得斜边长为 根号 2。
clips.text: 在边长为 1 的正方形中画一条对角线。对角线平分直角，得到 45°。两条直角边都是 1，由勾股定理得斜边长为 √2。

clips.send: 从观测者的水平线向上量到视线，得到仰角；向下量到视线，得到俯角。沿同一条视线从两端观测，两条水平线平行，所以仰角和俯角相等。

clips.send: 解直角三角形，就是根据已知条件求出其余的边长和角度。已知一条边和一个锐角时，选一个同时包含已知边和所求边的三角函数；已知两条边时，选一个包含这两条边的三角函数求角，再用勾股定理求第三边。

clips.send: 在边长为 2 的等边三角形中，从顶点向底边作高。这条高平分 60 度 的顶角，也平分底边。分成的两个直角三角形中，顶部的角是 30 度 ，底边上的锐角是 60 度 。短直角边长为 1，由勾股定理得另一条直角边长为 根号 (2 的平方 －1 的平方 )等于根号 3。
clips.text: 在边长为 2 的等边三角形中，从顶点向底边作高。这条高平分 60° 的顶角，也平分底边。分成的两个直角三角形中，顶部的角是 30°，底边上的锐角是 60°。短直角边长为 1，由勾股定理得另一条直角边长为 √(2²－1²)＝√3。

clips.send: 坡面与水平面的夹角叫坡角。坡度也叫坡比，等于铅直高度与水平距离之比，也就是坡角的正切。在美国，这个比值常用百分数表示，称为 percent grade（百分比坡度）。
